authority.scope: The SHAPEFILE reference is a hard pointer; relative handle codes represent soft pointers.

bug: The DWG SHAPE parser previously accepted any nonzero handle code and truncated five-byte targets to the public 32-bit handle, allowing the wrong object identity to be published.
change: Reuse the existing bounded, version-aware hard-pointer reader; keep the existing nonzero target requirement and reject targets outside the representable handle range. Failed parses reset state and invalidate the source buffer.

producer.independence: DWG codec descends from ACadSharp; do not count it as an independent ACadSharp vote or a native producer.

scratchReceipt.scope: generated producer controls, no native semantic claim

producer.repeat: Two independent runs generated identical SHA-256 for all four drawings.
producer.safety: Generator rejects output inside this repository and refuses an incorrect or modified pinned source. Generated DWGs and outputs remain in scratch.

validation.baseline: New R13/R14 controls failed for three non-null wrong codes and a five-byte handle on the unchanged parser; valid controls passed.
validation.release: Focused SHAPE CTest passes; R13/R14/R2000/R2004 literal bodies check hard pointer, soft/hard ownership, soft pointer and relative codes, null, truncation, 64-bit overflow and same-parser corrected retry. R13/R14 common headers are hand-authored; later common headers use the existing production encoder. Existing AC1015/1018/1021/1024 encode allocation-rollback controls also pass.
validation.asan: Fully instrumented library and focused SHAPE CTest pass.
validation.peer: LibreDWG 0.14 independently reads the generated SHAPE hard-pointer roles and both endpoints of the later 3D LINE; bound controls resolve the named shape-file STYLE, null controls do not. The candidate reads both bound controls without entity/object failures and refuses the null controls while reading the later LINE.
validation.cli: For each of four producer controls, strict and explicit-partial ASCII and Binary conversion refuse and preserve an existing destination because the producer outputs an unlinked ACAD_LAYOUT graph. This is not a successful partial-output or same-adapter retry qualification.

limits: The null SHAPEFILE is an unbound generated input, not established as a valid producer-authored entity failure. The layout dictionary remains orphaned; no partial-output gate is closed.
The .shx file and actual glyph appearance are not independently qualified.
The tests do not establish general SHAPE or DWG version support.
